[EN] They stole everything. All of it. As they left, they were sifting through my merchandise and taking out several of the headpieces. I'll bet you'd be able to collect them from the {@LinkCreature:5#3#Tuwangi Workers} themselves.

Do you think you could collect those while you're out looking for the bag itself?
[ES] Lo robaron todo. Absolutamente todo. Al irse, estuvieron revisando mi mercancía y se llevaron varios de los tocados. Apuesto a que podrás recolectarlos de los propios {@LinkCreature:5#3#Tuwangi Workers}.

¿Crees que podrías recogerlos mientras buscas la bolsa?

[EN] Oh, magnificent! These are worth quite a lot—I'd have had a hard time eating for a while if you hadn't gotten these back.

Thank you so much for your help.
[ES] ¡Oh, magnifico! Estos valen bastante; me habría costado mucho comer por un tiempo si no los hubieras recuperado.

Muchas gracias por tu ayuda.

[EN] Please collect the headpieces. They're really my livelihood. I'm not sure where my next meal will come from if I don't have those.
[ES] Por favor, recolecta los tocados. De verdad son mi sustento. No sé de dónde saldrá mi próxima comida si no los tengo.
